subject: Insurance
title: Your Driving Record
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Your Driving Record.

hook.text: One at-fault accident raises your premium 40-50%. A DUI can triple it. Your record is the biggest pricing factor.

buildup.text: Insurers check your record for accidents, tickets, and violations going back 3-5 years.

discovery.text: A clean record earns a 'good driver' discount of 10-25%.

twist.text: Some states ban surcharging for not-at-fault crashes. Others allow it. Location changes how your record affects price.

climax.text: Your driving record is your insurance resume. Every ticket and accident is a data point that follows you for years.
